# teams_feedback_policy (Data Source)

Look up an existing FeedbackPolicy object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `allow_email_collection` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowEmailCollection parameter.
- `allow_log_collection` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowLogCollection parameter.
- `allow_screenshot_collection` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowScreenshotCollection parameter.
- `enable_feature_suggestions` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableFeatureSuggestions parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `receive_surveys_mode` (String) Maps to the -ReceiveSurveysMode parameter.
- `user_initiated_mode` (String) Maps to the -UserInitiatedMode parameter.
